scenario: AITA for not directly paying my friend for half of the gas used on a trip? | I will keep this short. We went on a trip and used two tanks of gas. 1 tank there and 1 tank back. I used my company gas card to fill up when we left our home city (the tank was on empty). His argument was that since I didn't pay for it myself it didn't count, I think it does count since I still supplied us with half the tank and my method of acquiring the gas shouldn't matter.
